name: kiwi
description: Source suppliers and negotiate purchases through the Kiwi Buyer MCP server (A2A commerce runtime, pinned @harrylabsj/kiwi@0.8.0 via npx), with the kiwi-buyer sourcing workflow skill bundled. Buyer-side discovery, RFQ, negotiation, non-binding agreements and trade handoff. The skill runs dual-source sourcing searches: Kiwi Network results from kiwi_search, plus internet e-commerce listings through the host's own web tools when the session has them (a host capability, not a plugin guarantee — the skill reports the internet side as unsearched when they are unavailable). Kiwi never handles payments or places orders.
